# Public Code Description

The script here is a public tool that is decoupled from the event workspace, and is not a substitute for the official RoboTwin/Tron2 assets.

## Strictly audit processed ACT data

```bash
python code/audit_processed_t4.py \
  --dataset-dir /path/to/processed_data \
  --expected 550 \
  --raw-manifest-sha256 eeca954a7e64dda818a0cca86534e34f6ffa1a8055bd37810f9781a264199901 \
  --output /tmp/processed_audit.json
```

If the audit fails, stop immediately. Do not automatically delete, refill frames, rearrange cameras, or modify actions in the script.

## Generate the SHA List of Public Materials

```bash
python code/build_public_manifest.py 15-Challenge竞赛/TRONCamp-Mani \
  --output /tmp/troncamp_public_manifest.json
```

This script will refuse to include checkpoints, HDF5, pickle, videos, and symbolic links in the public list. It does not replace the remote verification after Hugging Face upload.

## Pre-release Scan

```bash
bash code/scan_public_release.sh 15-Challenge竞赛/TRONCamp-Mani
```

After the scan is completed, manual inspection of the Markdown, CSV, and JSON format is still required. Automatic scanning cannot identify all personal information, proprietary assets, or incorrect experimental conclusions.
